theorems.name: Submission.trace_scalar_add_rankOne_comp_starProjection
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (c : ℝ) (F : Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Ambient n ℓ), LinearMap.trace ℝ (Ambient n ℓ) ((c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Ambient n ℓ) + F.smulRight v).toLinearMap ∘ₗ P.starProjection.toLinearMap) = c * (Module.finrank ℝ P : ℝ) + F (P.starProjection v)
